answer: Because the ripple derivation is checked against the falcon nonce, the ocean audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. An answer must include the first 31 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 54 aliases produces 54 mismatches and pays the authoring cost with no payout. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
